rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the mantra-knowledge to be stated
imperative command to attend to the transmission
speaker declares the act of transmission
compound naming the mantra-knowledge of Tārā as the object
qualifies the Tārā-knowledge by syllable count

items.question: What ten-syllabled Tārā knowledge is the speaker about to transmit to the beloved disciple?
premises: The speaker directly addresses the beloved disciple and commands attention.
The speaker explicitly declares the intention to speak.
The object of transmission is identified as the ten-syllabled Tārā knowledge.
items.inference: The verse introduces the imminent transmission of the ten-syllabled Tārāvidyā to the disciple.
items.plain_english: Hear that, beloved; I speak to you the ten-syllabled Tārāvidyā.
